closed note 5089620 (near Minerva lakópark, Szombathely) / Created 11 months ago by toboz
In context of overlay "Things" – Bus Stop – https://osm.org/node/12465988116 via StreetComplete 62.0: Ez a megálló megszűnt? Ellenőrizni kellene Attached photo(s): https://streetcomplete.app/p/319925.jpg / Updated 10 days ago by SzilágyiGyula
Hi! Checked on-site / via Street View, the bus stop is definitely still there (with the stop sign and infrastructure intact). It should remain on the map. / Updated 10 days ago by toboz
Street View isn't really a reliable source in this case. Even if we consider it usable (which is not the case), the imagery is 14 years old here. The local bus network has undergone several changes since then, particularly after Blaguss took over Szombathely's local bus services in 2022. Based on the photo I took on-site, it seemed to me that this was a bus stop in the past, but is no longer in use. The former bus bay now appears to be used for parking. It's possible that the stop was discontinued as part of the network changes introduced by Blaguss, but I can't confirm that. It would be helpful if a mapper with sufficient local knowledge could verify whether this stop is actually still in service. / Updated 3 days ago by SzilágyiGyula
Hi! You're right about Street View, sorry for referencing it earlier. However, I live locally and can confirm with 100% certainty that the Minerva lakópark bus stop is actively in service. Just yesterday evening (Nov 17, 2026), I was right there on-site: a local Blaguss bus stopped in this exact bay, picked up a passenger, and continued its route. The blue bus stop sign, the current timetable, and the trash bin are all in place and maintained. Here is a fresh photo I took right after the bus left: https://kepkuldes.com/image/thaR6ue Please feel free to close this note, the stop is definitely active and valid. / Updated 3 days ago by toboz
Thanks for the photo, but it shows the bus stop on the opposite, western side of Demeter utca, next to the METRO. My note concerns the bus bay across the road, the eastern side. I've also checked the Blaguss' map and timetable and this(eastern side) bus stop is not listed there: https://szombathely.utas.hu/?map=18/47.25626/16.617 Your photo shows the western stop is active, but it doesn't prove anything about the bus bay in question. This I'm now fairly certain is no longer in use. Please don't close the note based on that photo. / Updated 3 days ago by toboz
Can you check the other side as well? / Updated 3 days ago by SzilágyiGyula
Most látom, hogy mehet magyrul is :) A megoldás a gondodra végtelen egyszerű. Tegnap ismét arra futottam, csak hogy tudjak neked érdemben segíteni. A helyzet a következő. Az egyik képen láthatod ahogy a Metro oldali megállóban áll 2 hölgy várva a buszt, tehát az a megálló aktív, ezt bizonyítja a másik kép, amin láthatod konkrétan milyen járatok. A csavar itt jön, mert odamentem hozzájuk és megkérdeztem mi a helyzet a másik oldallal, mert ott nem látok buszmegálló táblát és menetrendet, bár sziget van. Azt mondták azért, mert ezek a járatok a Minerván kört mennek, tehát csak egyirányabn közlekednek. Szóval a metro oldali megállót felteheted a térképre, a másik oldalit törölheted. https://kepkuldes.com/image/tha2DvL https://kepkuldes.com/image/tha2TKN https://kepkuldes.com/image/tha2mmq / Resolved 2 days ago by toboz
Szia, mehet magyarul, persze, igyekszem azon a nyelven válaszolni amin a másik ír. Köszönöm, hogy elmentél arra, a mostani képeken már látszik, hogy nincs ott megálló. Azt nem tudom, milyen "csavar jön", ;-) de szigetet a képeiden nem láttam, a két oldalon látható busz öblöket viszont felvettem az útra. A metro oldali megálló már eddig is jelölve volt, azt nem kell feltenni, a másikat pedig nem érdemes ilyenkor törölni, disused-ra állítottam. További jó térképezést!
